international.title: Iowa lead detonation: US army blows up bomb-making chemicals despite concerns - live updates
international.summary: Army detonates 68 barrels containing nearly 9,500lbs of lead azide despite public concern about potential health and environmental effects Full report: Smoke seen from a mile away as army detonates bomb-making chemicals Sign up for the Breaking News US email The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has activated an emergency response to support the Iowa Department of Health and Human Services to “provide accurate public health communication and technical assistance to our state and federal partners.” In a statement, the CDC said that at the request of the state of Iowa, it will support the state’s health department to develop “recommendations to help protect people from potential exposure to lead and air pollution” and in preparing to support the state with any “any post-event community health assessment needs.” Continue reading...
